Run the script with stdout connected directly to a terminal to see the progress bar update in place. When `tee` takes stdout, Rich detects a non-terminal through `Console.is_terminal` and uses non-interactive output. See the [Console docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst); usage questions belong in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
